## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 23, 2026 - Aug 13, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Huupla_, Aug 13, 2026, 1/5: "Every time I cleared a task it would recreate itself on the same day no matter how many times I deleted it. Makes the app unusable."
            2. _AARPRammy_, Jul 28, 2026, 2/5: "Now, not so much. Some time ago the devs updated the app, jammed in some AI nonsense, and made the user interface horribly unresponsive on the Mac. Every click now comes along with a free two second wait before the app responds! Not exactly ideal for impatient ADHD users trying to capture tasks, thoughts, etc. on the fly. Too bad. Moving to Things now as my to-do app. Will miss the micro-scheduling capabilities of Structured but I just cannot abide by the awful, slow interface."
            3. _jenniferagainn_, Apr 23, 2026, 3/5: "It’s very difficult to use on computer because it keeps crashing down. I have to force quit after 20 min every time"
